why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Paul Goldschmidt is slot #5 (4.666 expected team runs/game).
Slots #5, #3, #4, #6, #7, #8, #9, #1, #2 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.005 R/G.
Slot #5 yields 4.26 expected PA/game vs 4.69 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
